title: Rating
lead:
A `Rating` component allows users to provide a rating for a particular item.

`Rating` allows customers to determine a sense of value of a good or a service. By default, the rating is selected out of 5 stars, but the number and symbol used can be customized.

To display the result of other users' rating values, use `RatingDisplay` instead.

examples.name: Controlled Value
examples.description: The selected rating value can be controlled using the `value` and `onChange` props.

examples.name: Step
examples.description: You can specify half values in the Rating with `step={0.5}`.

examples.name: Max
examples.description: You can specify the number of elements in the Rating with the `max` prop.

examples.name: Shape
examples.description: You can pass in custom icons to the Rating component. You can specify the icons with the `iconFilled` and `iconOutline` props.

prose.text:
## Best practices

### Do

- Use a simple rating system.
- Use simple icons to represent rating items.

### Don't

- Display too many Ratings on the page at a time.
